create.name: Colette Baron-Reid
create.bio:
Colette Baron-Reid is a Canadian-born intuitive and author whose work centres on oracle cards as a way of holding a conversation with spirit and with one's own inner knowing. She has designed close to twenty oracle decks, among them Wisdom of the Oracle, The Spirit Animal Oracle and The Dream Weaver's Oracle, and written several books, including The Map and The Art of Manifesting. Before turning to teaching she had a career as a singer-songwriter, and she has spoken openly about the decades of sobriety that shaped her path; she has recently returned to recording music as well.

Her teaching is practical and warm. She shows beginners how to read cards for themselves in a few minutes a day, links each reading to journaling and intention, and treats manifesting as a creative partnership with a living universe rather than a set of tricks. She runs a monthly membership with live calls and readings, a training school for intuitive coaches, short video courses, occasional retreats abroad and a weekly podcast with guests from science and spirituality. Her YouTube channel carries monthly energy forecasts, card readings and conversations with other teachers.

books.title: The Art of Manifesting
books.author: Colette Baron-Reid
books.description: Sets out her method for manifesting as a partnership with the universe: getting clear on what you want to feel, making room to receive it and noticing the signs along the way. Written for readers who want a grounded, step-by-step approach.

books.title: The Map
books.author: Colette Baron-Reid
books.description: A guide to reading your own life as a story, using archetypal places and characters to see where you are stuck and which way to move. It mixes personal anecdote with reflective exercises.

books.title: You're in the Right Place
books.author: Colette Baron-Reid
books.description: A book about trusting where you are now as the starting point for change. She draws on her own turning points and offers practices for meeting uncertainty with curiosity instead of fear.

books.title: The Oracle Card Journal
books.author: Colette Baron-Reid
books.description: A guided journal for keeping a record of card readings, with prompts that help you notice patterns in the messages you draw over time. It works with any oracle deck.

books.title: The Dream Weaver's Oracle
books.author: Colette Baron-Reid
books.description: An illustrated oracle deck with a guidebook, built around the idea that we weave our lives the way a dreamer weaves a dream. Each card offers a theme for reflection and a short reading.

books.title: The Spirit Animal Pocket Oracle
books.author: Colette Baron-Reid
books.description: A travel-sized edition of her animal oracle, pairing each creature with a lesson drawn from the natural world. Comes with a small guidebook for quick daily draws.

books.title: Guides of the Hidden Realms Oracle
books.author: Colette Baron-Reid
books.description: A deck of fairy-tale and mythic guides that invites a more playful, imaginative style of reading. The accompanying booklet explains each figure and suggests simple spreads.

courses.title: Oracle Circle Membership
courses.description: A monthly online membership with live calls, teaching resources and members-only events where Colette gives readings. Members can cancel before any billing date.

courses.title: Oracle Cards 101
courses.description: A beginner's course spread over thirty days, with short daily lessons on reading oracle cards for yourself. It includes a digital deck and a set of recorded meditations.

courses.title: The Power of Journaling with Oracle Cards
courses.description: An online course that pairs card readings with written reflection, so that the messages turn into clearer choices. Around four hours of video teaching, kept for life.

courses.title: Puglia Retreat with Colette Baron-Reid
courses.description: Six nights in southern Italy by the Adriatic, with teaching, meditation, card guidance, journaling and ceremony based on her manifesting method. Booked through a travel company linked from her events page.

free_resources.title: Free Oracle Card Reading (Pick a Card)
free_resources.description: An online card draw on her website: choose one of her decks, ask a question and read the message for the card you pick. A quick way to try her style of reading.

free_resources.title: Colette Baron-Reid Presents (podcast)
free_resources.description: A weekly podcast of conversations with teachers, scientists and other guests about intuition, consciousness and spiritual life.
